lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: after a certain amount of time passes,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: the bubbles that you use grow on this tree, like fruit?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I typically create bubbles solely using my weapons systems,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: so making one large enough to cover this entire space would be impossible.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I used the bubbles I had available to create this tree,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: which acts as a sort of filter.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It gathers the disparate energy present in the ocean, and redirects it into the bubbles,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: which increases their surface area.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: So when you call this the bubble tree, you mean it's literally made of bubbles?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, and here I thought it was an actual tree.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I've never seen anything like this before. How extraordinary.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Can I touch it just once?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah uh!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Thanks.
Mihara carefully reaches out and touches the bubble tree.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's warm.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That's surprising. I thought it would be cold since it's made out of liquid.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: A tree made of liquid metal...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I want to check something.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Siren.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Excuse me for a moment.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh?
Mihara closes her eyes.
In order to exchange senses with the tree, she activates her ability.
The warmth of the water travels up the trunk of the tree,
and reaches the massive membrane that touches the ocean.
The frigid touch of ocean water.
And...
A sensation, like something is watching from beyond.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Mihara.
Little Mermaid grabs Mihara's arm.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: No, you can't. If you keep going, it'll be dangerous.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You mustn't draw attention to us.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I don't understand.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh uh.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: We're not ready yet, so we must lie low for now.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: My powers are weakened at the moment, and I can barely maintain the bubbles to keep us hidden as is.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: If we were to attract any unwanted attention, we'd have no way of fighting that thing.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Then you would never be able to return to the surface.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What is this "thing" you're talking about?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Something dangerous that doesn't understand language.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Were you hiding here from that thing too?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I quickly realized that my abilities have no effect on it.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: So I decided to stay out of sight until I'm ready.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: But, our arrival here

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: must surely have attracted its attention.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah uh.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: All we've done is put your life in danger. Why are you being so nice to us?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Are you suspicious of me as well, Mihara?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Not suspicious like Mori is, necessarily, but I am curious.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: We live in an era where people don't stick their necks out for others without good reason.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: We're not used to people being kind simply for the sake of being kind.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: So you can understand why I'm somewhat intrigued.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Why are you going so far out of your way to help us?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Why are you not more wary of us, a bunch of strangers?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Perhaps you're being this nice because of some hidden motive... or something.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Your arriving here felt like a divine gift.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I've been here on my own for so long.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Having the chance to talk to someone again felt like a gift.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: So I wanted to help you in any way possible,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: and be nice to you.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: How long have you been here?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: What year is it?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Here, I'll show you.
Mihara pulls out her phone and shows her the screen.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: So much time has passed already...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: If that date on the screen is correct, then I believe it's been about 70 years.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You've been here longer than I thought.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: And you've been alone this whole time?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah uh.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: No wonder you considered us a gift from above.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That would also explain why you've been so benevolent toward us.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I have to say, Siren, you seem like a real hard luck case.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I have to admit, I have a real soft spot for those kinds of people.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hmm... All right.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I had a whole bunch of questions I was going to ask you,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: but that can wait.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh uh?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Someday, you can tell your story.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: All of it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: We've experienced our fair share of hardships too, so no matter what your story is, we'll be able to handle it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Okay?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Ooh.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Thanks. Mihara.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Don't mention it.
After a week of life on the ocean floor,
Mori begins to feel there's something strange about this place.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What is wrong with you?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Why do you keep coming here and pestering me?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Don't you remember what I said?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I told you to drop the whole saint act!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh uh!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: And yet you insist on coming back here again and again.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Don't laugh!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'll leave soon.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Don't think that I'm gonna start opening up to you because of this.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... You're a real nutcase, you know that?
Every night, Little Mermaid comes to sit by Mori's burrow,
and plays with the bubbles for a while before leaving.
No matter how much Mori pushes her away, Little Mermaid steadfastly attempts to close the distance between them.
It's as if she's telling Mori she isn't alone.
Mori finds this kindness very unsettling.
It's both unfamiliar... and uncomfortable.
However, as another week passes,
what initially felt unfamiliar and uncomfortable begins to feel natural.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Mori, food!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... I was coming over here anyway.
Eating meals with someone becomes familiar.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo coo.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What are you looking at?

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo!
Yuni proudly holds up a box of canned food Mihara had found.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Is that... what I think it is?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Where did you find it?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Near the submarine.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I can't believe you found something like that over there...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Would you like to go together later?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I... I guess so.
Working together with someone becomes familiar.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Good night, Mori.
Sleeping around other people becomes familiar.
Another week passes.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: *Sigh*... Is there anything else to look through?
Mori stops rummaging through the boxes and steps outside.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Hrrrngh...!
Mori stretches as she looks at the now familiar oceanic landscape.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Huh?
Amongst the water, streaks of silvery liquid flow and undulate like a galaxy.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: How beautiful...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What's got you so mesmerized?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Don't sneak up on me like that!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Wow, I've never seen ocean water that color.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: How long has that been there?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: How would I know?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I just saw it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Where'd it come from, I wonder?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Siren,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: you see that silvery liquid?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Do you know what that...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Digestive liquid? But why...?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Siren?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Why do you look so worried? Is that stuff over there bad?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Everyone, inside!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What's gotten into her? What is that...
Mori looks out at the ocean again.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Huh?
There is a red light in the water.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What's that red light...?
The light flickers, reminiscent of a Rapture's core.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Are those... Raptures?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Th-they're coming this way!
The Raptures approach the barrier, their glowing cores burning red.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Since when can Raptures move underwater?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: From what I know,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: virtually all Raptures are incapable of that.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Siren.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What is this place?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Are we really in the ocean?
